svg.title: PL-300 Drainage & Water Riser Diagram
svg.text: TO BELOW-GROUND DRAINAGE — BY THE ENGINEER
LEVEL the whole building · schematic · METRES
1. The stack, level by level, from the tanks to the ground.
2. A diagram, not a drawing to scale, and it fixes one thing:
the riser runs the full height of the building in the east
strip, where the wet rooms were measured to stack on every
3. No size, capacity, rating or load appears. The engineer's
design fills them in; this reserves the space it has to
4. The connection below ground waits on GEO-001 and the
drainage design, and on whatever the authority requires at
EZBIT ABU RUKBAH, QUESNA, MENOUFIA, EGYPT
Coordination layout for the services engineer's design — no fitting, no size, no load. Not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P27 2026-10-11 the stair, which the interior cutaways did not show at all
P28 2026-10-11 ARC-400 centred: the last sheet still on the old wide origin
P29 2026-10-11 STR-200: the column schedule it was named for; heights corrected
P30 2026-10-12 site corrected to Ezbit Abu Rukbah; Code 305 named as the fire code
